title: Josiah knows about Max's nap and the 'First Fruits' chapter

tellings.quote: writes the next day you know I hope your nap was nice

plain: A boy named Josiah, one of the children in the Telepathy Tapes documentary about nonspeaking autistic children said to read minds, is said to have known things about a man named Max Davis that no one told him: the next day he wrote to Davis, 'I hope your nap was nice', and he is also said to have known about a chapter called 'First Fruits'. The filmmaker Ky Dickens, who made the documentary, tells Michels this as Davis and the family related it, as an example of what looks like telepathy.
